notes.title: The Wheel of Fortune is out!!
notes.content:
The only dating sim with Yugoslav folk-music is out now!

Play the role of a deadbeat internet junkie who wants to turn his life around. Lady Luck is a fickle mistress to you – after years of unlucky breaks, fate has brought three women into your life. Will you take hold of destiny's reins and start a new life with a hot Balkan girlfriend, or are you doomed to wallow in post-Soviet depression for the rest of your girlfriend-free days?

The Wheel of Fortune is the first visual novel to combine an anime aesthetic with Balkan culture and ex-Yugoslav melodies which makes it a unique game that has never been seen before both locally and globally!

Featuring

Three girls to romance or fail miserably
Six endings + one super secret ending 
Sampled Yugoslav folk-music as BGM (works surprisingly well!)
40+ scenes for your viewing enjoyment 
30+ tracks to discover and add to your playlists
A contemporary, relatable Balkan setting 
Presented in English for maximum accessibility (Can even be played by Albanians and Slovenians!!)


Only you have the power to turn The Wheel of Fortune
